The Book of Agentic AI is an  attempt to be a practical guide to understanding agents and building an AI toolkit you control. It is a living document, and the landscape is changing rapidly. The book is structured to provide both a high-level overview and practical guidance for building and using agentic AI systems.

The quarterly [Hotplate](/hotplate/2026-Q4-hotplate.qmd) offers a snapshot of
the current landscape. The 2026 Q4 edition highlights long-running open-source
agent harnesses, MCP as a default integration layer, persistent memory, and
self-hosted agents. It reflects a preference for tools readers can run and
control on their own hardware or an affordable server.

Use this book as a living toolkit: consult the chapters for practical
orientation, and follow the linked source materials and quarterly snapshots as
the landscape changes.
